capcut.role: editable source footage, supplied images, narration, music, SFX and final multitrack assembly

hyperframes.role: HTML/SVG/image/shape/text compound layers and frame-seekable motion overlays

remotion.role: reusable React compositions and specialist transparent graphics

gsap.role: shared animation language for HyperFrames and Remotion

d3.role: verified data-led maps, rescue timelines, graphs and relationships
d3.activation: only when the scene plan requests a data graphic

pixijs.role: GPU particles, dust, light and atmosphere
pixijs.activation: only when a visual effect is explicitly planned

matterjs.role: precomputed physics for a selected object simulation

lottie.role: render or composite an existing licensed Lottie animation
lottie.activation: only when a compatible supplied JSON asset exists

svgjs.activation: only if native SVG plus GSAP is insufficient

animejs.activation: disabled because GSAP is the common motion runtime

motion.activation: not a video renderer; not part of shot animation

motion_canvas.activation: deferred to avoid duplicating Remotion/HyperFrames render paths
